name: How does a real estate agent determine the best listing price for my home?

mainEntity.name: How does a real estate agent determine the best listing price for my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Real estate agents determine the best listing price by conducting a Comparative Market Analysis (CMA), which evaluates recently sold homes similar to yours, active listings, and expired listings in your area. They also consider your property's unique features, upgrades, condition, and market trends. For instance, in Miami-Dade County, specific neighborhood nuances and recent luxury developments can significantly impact pricing strategies. We also factor in seller motivations and timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Agents determine listing price through a Comparative Market Analysis (CMA), assessing sold and active listings, property features, and local market trends.
